hooks.command: $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = "$($in.tool_input.file_path)"; if ($p -like '*EA Agent*' -and $p -notmatch '\\logs\\|\\dashboard\\index\.html$') { New-Item -ItemType File -Path "$env:TEMP\claude-task-flag-ea-agent.txt" -Force | Out-Null }

if (Test-Path "$env:TEMP\claude-task-flag-ea-agent.txt") { Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\claude-task-flag-ea-agent.txt" -Force; Write-Output '{"systemMessage": "Files were changed this turn - run /task-complete to sync all tracking files."}' }
